incidents.headline: US strikes Iranian ports; IRGC declares Strait of Hormuz closed after attack on commercial vessel
incidents.summary: Fresh US strikes on Iranian port infrastructure followed an attack on a commercial vessel; the IRGC Navy declared the Strait of Hormuz closed to traffic.

incidents.headline: Iranian retaliatory missile and drone attacks on Gulf states hosting US forces; Bahrain activates national siren
incidents.summary: Retaliatory missile and drone launches from the Bandar Abbas area against Gulf states hosting US forces; Bahrain activated its national siren.

incidents.headline: Iranian strikes on civilian vessels 10-11 Oct 2026
incidents.summary: Iranian forces struck civilian vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz on 10-11 October 2026.

incidents.headline: Iranian drone strike ignites fire at Fujairah Oil Industry Zone, 3 injured; IRGC Navy map extends control zone over UAE east coast
incidents.summary: A drone strike ignited a fire at the Fujairah Oil Industry Zone, injuring three; an IRGC Navy map published the same week extends a declared control zone over the UAE east coast.

incidents.headline: Merchant tanker struck by projectiles 78 nm north of Fujairah; bulk carrier swarmed by small boats 11 nm off Iran
incidents.summary: UKMTO-reported incidents in the Gulf of Oman: a merchant tanker struck by projectiles 78 nm north of Fujairah and a bulk carrier swarmed by small boats 11 nm off the Iranian coast.

incidents.headline: Iranian drones hit Fujairah terminal, two crude tanks damaged, loadings suspended
incidents.summary: Iranian drones struck the Fujairah crude terminal on 14 and 16 March 2026; two storage tanks were damaged and loadings suspended.

incidents.headline: Kuwait air defences intercept Iranian drones; US resumes naval blockade of Iranian ports; tanker attacks near Oman
incidents.summary: Kuwaiti air defences intercepted Iranian drones as the US resumed a naval blockade of Iranian ports; further tanker attacks were reported near Oman.

incidents.headline: UAE records ~640,000 cyberattacks in one day, IRGC identified as main actor
incidents.summary: UAE cyber authorities recorded roughly 640,000 attacks in a single day, attributing the campaign primarily to the IRGC.

incidents.headline: UAE foils coordinated cyberattacks on aviation, energy and education sectors
incidents.summary: Coordinated cyberattacks on UAE aviation, energy and education sectors were foiled.

incidents.headline: Iran probing operations against US Navy in the Gulf
incidents.summary: Iranian naval units conducted probing operations against US Navy assets in the Gulf.

incidents.headline: Houthi and government forces contest Jabal Han overlooking western Taiz
incidents.summary: Houthi and government forces fought for Jabal Han, the high ground overlooking western Taiz.

incidents.headline: Houthis fire several ballistic missiles at Marib City
incidents.summary: Several Houthi ballistic missiles targeted Marib City.

incidents.headline: Houthi shelling of Taiz residential neighbourhoods; dozens of civilian casualties; Operation Dawn of Yemen advances in Marib (Maas camp, Medghal; al-Muqailat, Jabal Zajjar north of Harib)
incidents.summary: Houthi shelling of residential neighbourhoods in Taiz caused dozens of civilian casualties while government forces advanced in Marib (Maas camp, Medghal, al-Muqailat, Jabal Zajjar north of Harib).

incidents.headline: Southern Giants Brigades destroy five Houthi armoured vehicles near Dhubab Airport, Red Sea coast
incidents.summary: Southern Giants Brigades destroyed five Houthi armoured vehicles near Dhubab Airport on the Red Sea coast.

incidents.headline: Houthi projectiles strike near King Fahd Intl (Dammam) and King Khalid Intl (Riyadh)
incidents.summary: Houthi projectiles launched from the Red Sea coast struck near King Fahd International (Dammam) and King Khalid International (Riyadh). Tagged to the Yemen launch area.

incidents.headline: Yemeni armed forces conduct strikes against Houthis in Sanaa
incidents.summary: Yemeni armed forces conducted strikes against Houthi positions in Sanaa.

incidents.headline: Houthis seize Mocha port and Zuqar Island, advance toward Bab el-Mandeb; Brent above $100
incidents.summary: Houthi forces seized Mocha port and Zuqar Island and advanced toward Bab el-Mandeb; Brent crude moved above $100.

incidents.headline: Saudi-led coalition strikes Houthi positions around Mocha; Houthis claim F-15 shot down over Marib; Saudi interceptor stocks low
incidents.summary: Saudi-led coalition strikes on Houthi positions around Mocha; the Houthis claimed an F-15 shot down over Marib while Saudi interceptor stocks ran low.

incidents.headline: Houthi naval blockade of Saudi Red Sea ports; attacks on Aramco Yanbu and Jizan; Bab el-Mandeb transits fall to 11 vessels/day
incidents.summary: A Houthi naval blockade of Saudi Red Sea ports and attacks on Aramco Yanbu and Jizan cut Bab el-Mandeb transits to about 11 vessels a day.

incidents.headline: Saudi coalition strikes Mukalla port targeting UAE-linked weapons shipment; UAE announces withdrawal from Yemen
incidents.summary: Saudi coalition strikes on Mukalla port targeted a UAE-linked weapons shipment; the UAE announced its withdrawal from Yemen.

incidents.headline: NISA kills former al-Shabaab Amniyat chief Bashir Ahmed Haji Nunow in Jilib
incidents.summary: Somali NISA operation in Jilib killed the former al-Shabaab Amniyat chief Bashir Ahmed Haji Nunow.

incidents.headline: Ethiopia to withdraw 3,000+ troops from Somalia
incidents.summary: Ethiopia announced the withdrawal of more than 3,000 troops from Somalia (Baidoa/Buurhakaba sector).

incidents.headline: Piracy off Somalia at highest level since 2013: 15 attacks in 2026, 8 in Gulf of Aden since May
incidents.summary: IMO data analysis: 15 piracy attacks off Somalia in 2026, eight of them in the Gulf of Aden since May — the highest level since 2013.

incidents.headline: Tanker Honour 25 hijacked north of Eyl by ~30 pirates; 17 crew hostage, vessel still held
incidents.summary: The tanker Honour 25 was hijacked north of Eyl by about 30 pirates; 17 crew are held hostage and the vessel remains in pirate hands.

incidents.headline: Puntland seizes three FGS-aligned bases; AUSSOM accelerated handoff at Buurhakaba
incidents.summary: Puntland forces seized three FGS-aligned bases while AUSSOM accelerated its handoff at Buurhakaba.

incidents.headline: Pro-FGS and Puntland forces clash in northern Somalia
incidents.summary: Clashes between pro-FGS and Puntland forces in northern Somalia.

incidents.headline: US airstrikes on ISIS-Somalia in Golis Mountains southeast of Bosaso and al-Shabaab near Buur Heybo
incidents.summary: US airstrikes targeted ISIS-Somalia in the Golis Mountains south-east of Bosaso and al-Shabaab near Buur Heybo.

incidents.headline: Somalia annuls all agreements with UAE incl. Berbera and Bosaso port/defence deals; DP World says Berbera operations continue
incidents.summary: Somalia annulled all agreements with the UAE, including the Berbera and Bosaso port/defence deals; Somaliland and Puntland rejected the move and DP World said Berbera operations continue.

incidents.headline: UAE fast-tracks West-East Pipeline to double Hormuz-bypass export capacity by 2027
incidents.summary: The UAE fast-tracked the West-East Pipeline alongside the existing Habshan-Fujairah ADCOP line to double Hormuz-bypass export capacity by 2027.

incidents.headline: ADNOC offers Das/Upper Zakum loadings outside the Gulf via STS off Fujairah and Sohar
incidents.summary: ADNOC offered Das and Upper Zakum crude loadings outside the Gulf via ship-to-ship transfer off Fujairah and Sohar.

incidents.headline: UAE releases 10 Iranian fishermen detained after GPS jamming pushed boats into Emirati waters
incidents.summary: The UAE released ten Iranian fishermen detained after GPS jamming pushed their boats into Emirati waters off Ras Al Khaimah.
